title: Listen and Choose a Response — Travel

questions.stem: Do you know which gate the flight to Denver leaves from?

options.A: Let's check the departure screen over there.
options.B: It leaves at a quarter past six.
options.C: I've never been to Denver before.
options.D: The gate was open when I came in.

questions.explanation: Suggesting the departure board is a practical indirect answer. The others answer when, comment on Denver, or use 'gate' in a different sense.
questions.speaker: m6
